summary.text: Greg Vitali is a Democrat who has represented Pennsylvania's 166th Legislative District since 1992, when his biography says he became the first Democrat ever elected to the seat, and he has served on the House Environmental Committee for 31 years, 11 of them as Democratic chairman.

paragraphs.text: Vitali is a lifetime resident of Haverford Township and a graduate of St. Joseph's Prep; he received a B.S. in economics, cum laude, from Villanova University and a J.D. from Villanova University School of Law.
He was a solo practitioner in Havertown for 12 years and later an adjunct professor at Villanova University, teaching state and local government.
His biography says he was the first Pennsylvania legislator to introduce climate change legislation and the first to propose a severance tax on natural gas.
